# Attachment filtering keeps repeated part IDs paired with detached file URLs

stripAttachments removes missing-part and descendant-part URLs from its input Map, preserving the remaining insertion order rather than performing the numeric sort pictured in the comment. It appends repeated del values and, for detach, one corresponding detachTo file URL per kept entry. The native parser reads both repeated arrays and multipart matching selects the file path at the matching part index. Accepted code uses URLParams rather than the historical whole-query unescape/manual splitter. The selected later test detaches under an ampersand directory and directly checks the intact external URL. These are source and written-test contracts, not executed encoding, all-filename or malformed-query guarantees.

Scope: Attachment URL producer and native MIME consumer.
